content: Window capture options on Windows: BitBlt+GetDC returns black for hidden/minimized windows (no pixels to copy); CAPTUREBLT (0x40000000) is needed to include layered/DWM surfaces for occluded-but-visible windows but does not help if minimized. PrintWindow asks the target to render itself and works off-screen; on Win8.1+ requires PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT (0x2) to capture DirectX/DWM-composited content — without it, DirectX games render black. Windows.Graphics.Capture (Win10 1803+) is the modern supported path for per-window capture including background/occluded windows. Desktop Duplication API cannot capture most fullscreen-exclusive D3D/OpenGL apps. Anti-cheat (GameGuard/HackShield/EAC) blocks OBS Game Capture because the OBS hook is process injection; Display Capture and Window Capture (no injection) are the safe workaround.
